name: ralph-suite
description: Autonomous AI task runner with Kanban board, memory and multi-engine support

ralph-suite.engine.description: AI engine to use for task execution

ralph-suite.autoRun.description: Automatically start next task when one completes

ralph-suite.freshContext.description: Open a new chat window for each task (fresh context, no history bleeding between tasks). Recommended: true.

ralph-suite.prdPath.description: Path to prd.json relative to workspace root

default: Never modify prd.json
Never delete files without confirmation
Always include tests for new features
Task states must be exactly: todo | inprogress | completed | blocked — never mix or invent states
When a task is finished, write the completion signal and wait for instructions — do not generate extra questions unless explicitly part of the task
Always read .agent/memories.md before starting any task to load project context
Never commit secrets, API keys, tokens or passwords — use environment variables
Always validate and sanitize user inputs — never trust raw input
Run existing tests before marking a task as completed — do not break passing tests
Security checkpoints required for: authentication changes, file deletions, DB schema changes, dependency upgrades
All new code must follow the conventions already present in the codebase — check existing patterns before creating new ones
Log important decisions and architectural choices in .agent/memories.md
Never use placeholders or TODO comments in production code — implement or leave existing code
If blocked, write a clear explanation in the note signal — do not silently timeout
ralph-suite.guardrails.description: Rules injected into every task prompt

ralph-suite.boundaries.description: Paths the agent must never touch (e.g. legacy/**, *.lock)

ralph-suite.taskTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for the agent to complete a task before timing out. Default: 10 minutes.

ralph-suite.taskRetries.description: Number of times to retry a task after timeout before marking it as failed. Default: 1.

ralph-suite.minWaitMs.description: Minimum time (ms) to wait before starting to poll for task completion. Default: 15 seconds.

ralph-suite.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to check if the agent has completed a task. Default: 5 seconds.

ralph-suite.agentRole.description: Role of the AI agent — appears in AGENTS.md header

ralph-suite.agentStack.description: Tech stack of the project (e.g. PHP 8.1, WordPress, Python 3.11, JavaScript). Used to personalise AGENTS.md.

ralph-suite.agentProject.description: Short project description for AGENTS.md context

default: Delete files or directories
Modify database schemas or migrations
Change authentication or security configuration
Install or upgrade major dependencies
Refactor more than 500 lines of code
Change architecture documented in plans/
ralph-suite.agentCheckpoints.description: Actions that require a checkpoint confirmation before executing
